title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could let stablecoin partners print new tokens
summary: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
No proof of AI in North Korean hackers move of stolen Binance funds
summary: Elliptic tracked thousands of transfers, failed swaps and repeated transactions that suggest the hackers relied on scripts rather than AI agents.

title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.

title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
summary: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.
